requirements.title: ADVANCE values are YES or NO
requirements.definition: The scalar default character expression in an ADVANCE= specifier shall evaluate to YES or NO.

pending.advance-yes-value: Positive control uses ADVANCE="YES" on a formatted external sequential transfer that otherwise satisfies C1223.
pending.advance-no-value: Positive control uses ADVANCE="NO" in the same admitted context and observes nonadvancing behavior through EOR/SIZE after those rules are registered.
pending.advance-other-value-source-control: Source-control negative changes only the ADVANCE value to "MAYBE"; diagnostic status is not claimed here because the value rule is unnumbered and C1225 covered ASYNCHRONOUS only.

requirements.title: Formatted child data transfers are nonadvancing and ignore ADVANCE
requirements.definition: A formatted child data transfer statement is nonadvancing, and any ADVANCE= specifier is ignored.

pending.formatted-child-transfer-nonadvancing: Use future defined I/O child transfer controls with a sentinel-filled parent record; assert only the child transfer is nonadvancing once 15.x child I/O rules are registered.
pending.child-advance-specifier-ignored: Paired child defined-I/O controls differing only by ADVANCE value must produce the same portable parent-record effect; this is deferred until child data transfer syntax is registered.

accounting.rationale: Single paragraph mixes value restriction, nonchild effects, default value, and child-transfer behavior.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.2.2-12.6.2.16, the individual io-control-spec specifiers (batch160). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Each temporary mode specifier is split into its value restriction, its one-statement effect with restoration of the connection mode (observed by INQUIRE after the statement), and the omitted-means-unchanged rule. Round 1 found a pending plan expecting exact output from I2 on a positive value without fixing the sign mode; it now uses SS, and a sweep found no other plus-, leading-zero- or rounding-dependent exact output. R1215 and C1232 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
